native_context: Deletion-state propagation and residual application access
taxonomy_note: Planning compatibility lens only. Classify the final observed root cause independently; unsupported mappings stay unassigned.

controls.boundary: Deletion-state propagation and residual application access — authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Read the product's deletion/access promise and trace records through APIs, exports, caches, retained copies and tenant/account entitlement. Separate logical deletion from physical erasure claims.
controls.controlled_verification: Create a private synthetic marker, delete it through the intended flow and compare normal reads plus one evidenced alternate consumer after the documented propagation window. Use the same prohibited/entitled identity context and inspect whether retained copies remain accessible contrary to policy.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Backups or legally retained records existing are not by themselves an access violation. A soft-delete flag without a retrieval path does not prove continued disclosure, and this review does not determine legal retention duties.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Apply the declared access/deletion contract across the affected consumers and propagation lifecycle. Retest the original accessible copy, legitimate retained/admin behavior and normal deletion.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
